title: Paper Lantern Hours
brief: Lo-fi hip-hop study beat, ~2 min, seamless loop: worn electric piano on seventh chords, round upright bass, swung dusty drums, vinyl; a short motif (up a step, back, down to the sixth) keeps returning.

sections.intent: Worn electric piano and vinyl alone; the loop seam lives here
Drums and bass enter; the motif arrives in the last four bars
Motif stated twice, answered and varied
Brighter IV-centred chords, half-time drums, motif in fragments
Motif returns with a high echo, fullest point
Drums and bass fall away so the end meets the intro

decisions: Motif (C D C A) heard in the cycle A bars, moved down in the bridge, lifted at its end in the answer phrase.
